entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: EU member-state or third-country government acting through Council votes and diplomacy

attributes.name: council_vote_2024
attributes.description: Position in 4 Oct 2024 Council vote: in favour/against/abstain

entity_types.selection_rule: Sovereign governments or state ministries whose votes/diplomacy causally affect the tariff outcome
anti_examples: European Commission (an EU institution, not a member-state government)
levers: Cast Council vote on trade measures
Joint letters pressing Commission for new instruments
Grant or withhold bilateral support for settlements

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Firms, associations, institutions and adjudicatory bodies central to the dispute

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Industry/sector, e.g. automotive, trade administration, judiciary

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Functional role: OEM, regulator, arbitrator, association

entity_types.selection_rule: Any corporate, institutional or adjudicatory body whose decisions causally affect duties, undertakings, litigation or retaliation

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Named individual leaders acting in own decision capacity
entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals with personal decision authority over negotiation or policy in this dispute
levers: Broker understandings such as the 9 October 2026 deal

entity_types.name: Other
entity_types.description: Affected exporter groups targeted by retaliation measures

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Export sector, e.g. brandy, dairy, pork

attributes.name: exposure
attributes.description: Duty rates or minimum-price regime currently applied

examples: Chinese brandy, dairy and pork exporters to China
entity_types.selection_rule: Aggregated exporter communities whose retaliation exposure constrains EU negotiating choices
levers: Comply with or breach minimum-price undertakings

entity_types.name: TradeDefenceInstrument
entity_types.description: Concrete EU or Chinese trade measures in force (duties, undertakings, safeguards)
entity_types.selection_rule: Specific named legal instruments or measures whose state at 30 June 2027 defines the forecast outcomes
entity_types.selection_note: Object being forecast; not an agent

entity_types.name: MarketSector
entity_types.description: Tracked product markets affected by the dispute

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Product category, e.g. BEV, PHEV, brandy

attributes.name: trade_exposure
attributes.description: Key statistics: import values, shares, growth

entity_types.selection_rule: Concrete product markets whose trade flows are tracked as evidence for substitution and retaliation
entity_types.selection_note: Passive tracked object, not an agent

entity_types.name: Source
entity_types.description: Media, research and data providers cited as evidence
entity_types.selection_rule: Cited outlets and reports providing evidence; never simulated as decision-makers

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Authority imposes or administers trade measures on a firm or sector

attributes.name: instrument
attributes.description: Legal act or measure through which regulation applies

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: Applicable duty rate or undertaking terms

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source authority imposes/administers measures over target firm or exporter group

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Negotiating partnership between Commission and MOFCOM or commissioner
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source negotiates jointly with target on undertakings or understandings

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Adversarial stance in negotiations or litigation

attributes.name: issue
attributes.description: Bone of contention, e.g. company-level carve-outs

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source contests target's position or measure

edge_types.name: SANCTIONS
edge_types.description: Imposes retaliatory duties or investigations on target exporters
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source imposes retaliation measures against target's exporters

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Firm subject to authority's acceptance decisions (undertaking applicant)

attributes.name: arrangement
attributes.description: e.g. accepted undertaking, individual duty rate

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source firm seeks or holds arrangements granted by target authority

edge_types.name: BACKS
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source government politically supports target's measures

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Government or actor exerts pressure on Commission decisions
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source pressures target's decision-making (e.g. Council over Commission)

edge_types.name: ALLY_OF
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source and target act as coalition partners on trade policy

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: Position advocated, e.g. against duties, for trade defence

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source association lobbies or advocates for target firms

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Firms rely on home government for protection or market access

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: e.g. protective duties, China market access, retaliation exposure

edge_types.direction_semantics: Source firm's interests depend on target government's actions

analysis_summary: 该预测问题属于贸易政策/地缘经济领域：欧盟对华BEV反补贴税在2027年6月30日前维持、被价格承诺取代或被修改，以及中国是否报复欧盟汽车出口。核心决策者是欧委会（DG TRADE，独家接受承诺与复审权）、中国商务部（谈判对手+报复权）、德法两国政府（理事会政治地图）、WTO DS630专家组（裁决方）以及中欧车企（承诺申请方与报复暴露方）。本体保留阵容种子类型 Organization/Person/Government/Other，并新增三个领域类型：TradeDefenceInstrument（被预测的法律工具客体）、MarketSector（贸易流证据客体）和 Source（被引用媒体/智库，tier 3 被动信息源）。关系覆盖治理（REGULATES、DS630诉讼）、对抗（OPPOSES、SANCTIONS、TRIGGERS报复联动）、经济（CUSTOMER_OF、TARGETS）与因果传导（CAUSES税收→贸易替代效应），并附带 rate/status/lag/strength 等预测可用属性。
